source: Hacker's Delight, 2nd ed. (H. S. Warren), section 13-1 "Gray Code"
description: Gray code to binary conversion by a prefix-xor shift cascade
notes: Standard non-loop Gray-to-binary conversion (also on the Wikipedia 'Gray code' page); function written by us from the idea. clang trunk -O3 -march=skylake keeps the five lshr/xor pairs: 11 IR instructions. Whether a shorter form exists is unknown.
